notes: A cut-down remake of bhop_badges by a different mapper, and it is timed the same way the original is, with one word changed: the original's finish is the single trigger_teleport aimed at `end`, and this one's is the single trigger_teleport aimed at `ziel` (German for 'finish'). It is a 64x64x32 pad at [15296 -11360 2704], 900 units past destination `51` -- the highest of the numbered section returns `1`..`51` -- so it is the far end of the chain, and it lands the player at [1728 -3136 15104], back beside the start. The start is unlabelled and is the spawn block, as in the original: all 56 info_player_terrorist entities stand at z 14928 in a 1024x384 rectangle ([1216..2240, -2880..-2496]), with section `1`'s pits starting at y -2304. UNLIKE the original, sections here are joined by doors: twenty-odd unfiltered 64x64x128 trigger_teleports (and a 128x48 one into `51`) stand at the far end of a section aimed at the next section's destination -- [13792 -3776] at the end of section 23 sends you to `24` across the map -- so `doorways` is on, at 128 units, which takes every door and leaves every floor-sized pit (352 units and up) a RESPAWN. Sections are not emitted as stages: the numbered destinations are points, most sections are entered by walking rather than through a volume, and the original is zoned without them. THE BIG DOUBT IS NOT THE ZONES: 252 of the 363 trigger_teleports are 1-unit-thick pads on the tops of bhop blocks, filtered on `filter_activator` -- they fire only for a player a func_button/trigger renamed `activator` for a tenth of a second, i.e. one who stood on a block too long. The importer does not read `filtername`, so every one of them becomes a volume that fires on every landing.

conditional_teleports.note: the map's anti-standing trap: a trigger_multiple on each block sets the player's name to the one this filter passes after a delay and resets it after another, so the teleport only fires on a player who stood on a block too long. This game does not run the map's outputs, so imported unconditionally it fired on every landing. Dropped; standing still is allowed here and costs the player time instead

zones.note: the spawn block: the bounding box of all 56 info_player_terrorist entities, plus margin; stops short of the 64x24 door at y -2988 behind it
the middle of the spawn block, on the floor the 56 spawns stand on, facing +y down section 1
the single 64x64 pad aimed at `ziel`, past the last section return `51`
